summary: FM electric piano (DX7-style): glassy, 80s ballads and synth-pop
label: FM electric piano
body: Bright 80s chords and arpeggios. The General MIDI one: GeneralUser GS/FM Electric Piano.

Register: MIDI 40-88 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: openDAW/Rhodes, openDAW's factory preset for Tubular (its DX7-style FM synth): make_instrument (sound "openDAW/Rhodes") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
